FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 103
Committee: Children and Senior Advocacy Sponsor: Representative Leigh Hulsey
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 103 as introduced creates the Youth Athlete Protection Act. This act could increase
the obligations of certain local governments by an undetermined amount, and is dependent
upon (1) the cost of certain the training, provided by the department of Human Resources; and
(2) the number of coaches that are required to be trained annually.
In addition, this act would increase the administrative obligations DHR by an undetermined
amount dependent on the cost to (1) adopt and publish a Youth Athlete Protection Policy; (2)
track and monitor compliance of youth sports organizations and local govenrments with the
provisions of this bill; (3) publish a list of all certified organizations and local governments on
their website; and (4) develop a mandatory reporter training program for coaches of youth
athletes.
